articles.title: Grafton Group (LSE:GFTU) Stock Still Looks Like A Bargain On Cash Flow
articles.summary: Grafton Group shares have logged steady gains in recent years, and the latest move higher puts fresh focus on whether the current valuation is supported by the cash the business can generate. For anyone tracking the stock, the issue is no longer just recent returns, but how those cash flows stack up against today's price.
